name: Frozen Pond
desc: A sheet of black ice running away to the horizon — a dark mirror crazed with white feathery thermal cracks and strings of bubbles frozen mid-rise, the reflection of overhead lights smeared down it and wobbling as the ice is never quite flat; nocturne black ice, a bright daylight pond with snow dust, a teal-glass tarn, or a white-line engraving.

energy.doc: how bright and how far the reflected light streaks smear and slide across the ice

scale.doc: crack and bubble scale — min a dense fine crazing, max a few great feather cracks

density.doc: frost motes / snow drifting low over the ice

cracks.doc: how heavily the ice is crazed — from a nearly clear sheet to a dense feather-crack network

x.doc: vanishing point x as a canvas fraction

y.doc: horizon y as a canvas fraction — everything above stays fully transparent so the bg shows through

style.doc: aesthetic: dark nocturne black ice mirroring overhead lights / a bright daylight pond with settled snow dust / a teal-glass tarn / a white-line engraving of the crack network on near-black / a cyan setting-out plan

seed.doc: crack lottery — the branching of the feather cracks and the placement of the bubble strings
